note: Ten UK financing options built from public sources checked on 14 October 2026. Published figures are quoted in each product's source block. Anything a provider does not publish is listed under 'assumed'. Real offers depend on the provider's checks. This is information, not a quote or an offer.

products.name: Lloyds Bank business overdraft
products.notes: Interest only on what you use. Needs a Lloyds Business Current Account.

published: Borrow between £500 and £50,000, instant decision
Representative 15.62% EAR (variable) for unsecured overdrafts up to £25,000
£500 to £25,000: 10.85% a year above Bank of England Bank Rate
£500 to £5,000: £12 monthly fee. £5,001 to £25,000: 1.99% annual fee, minimum £150
Must hold a Lloyds Business Current Account. Limited companies and LLPs may need a guarantee
assumed: Rate = Bank Rate 3.75% + 10.85% = 14.60% a year
Above £25,000 Lloyds prices on application, so Triody stops at £25,000
Half the limit is in use on average (repay_fraction 0.5)
Money usable 1 day after the decision
A 'fair' credit profile or better is needed (Lloyds says 'subject to status')

products.name: HMRC Time to Pay (tax payment plan)
products.notes: Pay a tax bill in instalments. Only covers tax you owe HMRC. Ask HMRC before the due date, and no later than day 15, to avoid the first late payment penalty.

published: If you cannot pay your tax bill in full, you may be able to set up a payment plan to pay it in instalments. HMRC will check if a payment plan is affordable for you
VAT plan online if you owe £50,000 or less, plan to pay within 12 months and have filed all returns
Late payment interest 7.75% from 9 January 2026 (base rate plus 4%)
First VAT late payment penalty is 3% of the VAT owed at day 15. Ask for Time to Pay on or between days 1 and 15 to avoid it
assumed: Interest charged at the late payment rate on the unpaid balance
Plan agreed within a day of calling HMRC
Capped at £50,000 and 12 months, the online limits. Larger or longer plans need a call and are not modelled
No credit check (HMRC checks affordability instead)

products.name: iwoca Flexi-Loan
products.notes: Fast and flexible, but expensive. Needs a personal guarantee.

published: Borrow £1,000 - £1,000,000 for 1 day to 2 years
Rates start at 1.5% a month
Example: £10,000 for 12 months at 49% representative APR, interest rate 40% p.a. (variable)
No early repayment fees. Funds typically in your account in hours
All we need is a personal guarantee
assumed: Costed at the representative 40% a year, not the 'from' rate
Minimum 6 months of trading (iwoca does not publish one)
A 'fair' credit profile or better

products.name: Funding Circle business loan
products.notes: Lowest advertised unsecured rate. Limited companies and LLPs only.

published: Borrow £10,000 to £750,000. Rates from 6.9% per year
Decision in as little as 5 minutes. Funds typically within 48 hours. No fees to settle early
Review site (secondary source): terms 6 months to 6 years, limited companies and LLPs only, 1+ year trading, completion fee set in the quote and not published
assumed: Costed at the 'from' rate of 6.9%, the best case. Real offers are often higher
Completion fee left out because it is not published, so the true cost is understated
A 'good' credit profile is needed for anything near the advertised rate

products.name: Start Up Loan (British Business Bank)
products.notes: Government-backed personal loan for business use. Comes with free mentoring.

source.provider: Start Up Loans, a British Business Bank programme
published: Borrow up to £25,000. Fixed interest rate of 7.5% per year. Repay over 1-5 years
Starting a new business or trading for up to 60 months. 18 or over, UK resident, business based in the UK
You're unable to secure finance from other sources (self-declaration is ok)
Personal loans for business use only
assumed: Minimum £500 (Triody assumption, the site gives only the maximum)
About 21 days from application to money, since a business plan is needed. Not published
A 'fair' credit profile or better (the site says 'you pass our credit checks')

products.name: Lloyds Cardnet merchant cash advance (by Liberis)
products.notes: Repaid as a share of daily card takings. A fixed fee is charged even if you repay early.

published: Business finance available from £1,000 to £500,000
Example: £10,000 advance, fixed fee £1,500 (if a 15% fee agreed), payment percentage 20% of all card transactions
At least four months' card trading history, minimum £1,000 in card payments a month, existing Cardnet customers
Funds could be in your account two working days after acceptance
Market index June 2026 (Spark Finance): factor rates typically 1.1 to 1.5
assumed: Fee of 15% (factor 1.15), as in the Lloyds example
Repaid within 3 to 12 months
At least half of sales by card, so repayments keep pace

products.name: Invoice finance (market rates)
products.notes: Advance against unpaid customer invoices. Your customers' payments repay it. No single provider: costed at market index rates.

source.provider: Market index (Spark Finance UK Invoice Finance Rate Index, June 2026)
published: Service fee, standard established SME: 0.8% to 1.8% of turnover
Discount charge, standard: SONIA + 2.5% to 4.5% a year
Advance rate 70% to 90% of invoice value
Minimum annual turnover £100,000 (some lenders from £50,000)
Indicative only, not quotes
assumed: Mid-points used: service fee 1.3%, discount SONIA + 3.5%, advance 85%
SONIA taken as equal to Bank Rate (3.75%), so discount = 7.25% a year
Service fee charged each month on the invoices behind the advance (advance / 0.85)
About 10 days to set up. Not published

products.name: Longer payment terms from an existing supplier
products.notes: Negotiated with a supplier you already use. Not a public product, so the cost is an assumption.

assumed: No public rate exists. Triody assumes a 1.5% cost, about the size of a lost early-payment discount
Suppliers rarely extend more than 3 months or more than £30,000 for a small customer
About 3 days to agree

products.name: Equipment hire purchase (market rates)
products.notes: Secured on the equipment you buy, not on other assets. A deposit is usually needed.

source.provider: Market index (Spark Finance UK Asset Finance Rate Index, June 2026)
published: Plant and machinery: prime 7% to 12% APR, specialist or higher risk 12% to 22% APR
Terms 1 to 7 years. Deposit 10% to 25% typical. Minimum trading 12 months typical, 2+ years for best rates
Indicative only, not quotes
assumed: Mid-points used: 9.5% for a good credit profile, 17% for fair
Amounts £5,000 to £500,000. Not published
About 7 days to arrange. Not published
Deposit not modelled

products.name: Property-secured business loan (market rates)
products.notes: Lowest rates, but property is at risk if you cannot repay.

source.provider: Market index (Spark Finance UK Business Loan Rate Index, June 2026)
published: Secured against property: prime (LTV below 60%) 3% to 7% APR, standard (LTV 60-75%) 7% to 15% APR
Secured terms 1 to 25 years. Most lenders require at least 6 months of trading, 2+ years for the best rates
Indicative only, not quotes
assumed: Mid-points used: 5% for a good credit profile, 11% for fair
1% arrangement fee. Not published
Amounts from £25,000. Minimum 24 months of trading. About 30 days for valuation and legal work
